title: September Gamedev Work Night
description:
St. Louis County Library Clark Family branch is hosting casual work time for local game developers in the Creative Lab. Bring your project to work on and talk with other devs for feedback or fun. This is open to EVERYONE ages 14 and up. 

For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/316753085
location: St. Louis County Library - Clark Family Branch, 1640 S Lindbergh Blvd, St. Louis, MO 63131, USA

title: Spooky Jam 2026
description:
It's Spooky Season, which means it's time for another Spooky Jam! We encourage everyone to make games but we will accept creations of all kinds for this jam! Feel free to make a video game, board game, card game, visual art, comic, zine, song, music album, visual novel, poem, short story, sculpture... anything! 
For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/316699612

title: October GameDev Social!
description:
Chat with fellow creators about making, playing, and admiring games! Talk about your game ideas and get inspired! Make friends and find collaborators. Our monthly hangout is open to EVERYONE!

For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/316205663
location: Schlafly Bottleworks, 7260 Southwest Ave, St. Louis, MO 63143, USA

title: Game Club: 🎃?
description:
Game Club is like a book club except we pick a game to play each month and then meet up to discuss it with a focus on game design. Our game for this month is being voted on right now!
 
For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see:https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/316753984/
location: Sauce on the Side, 701 N New Ballas Rd, Creve Coeur, MO 63141, USA

title: Share & Play: Game Playtesting!
description:
Join us for casual game playtesting! This is an opportunity for developers to share their progress, observe playtesting, and get feedback on their projects, and for local game enthusiasts to get their hands on new games, prototypes, and give helpful feedback. 
 
For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/314944382
